// Regenerates testdata/pep_handshake_golden.json's vectors from the platform's
// own encoder. Kept as .go.txt so no tool in this repository treats it as Go.
//
// At a platform commit <SHA> of the enterprise repository:
//
//   git archive <SHA> platform/decision | tar -x -C <scratch>
//   mkdir -p <scratch>/platform/decision/cmd/golden
//   cp this file <scratch>/platform/decision/cmd/golden/main.go
//   cd <scratch>/platform/decision && go run ./cmd/golden > vectors.json
//
// Each header is produced by contract.PEPHandshake.Encode and round-tripped
// through contract.DecodePEPHandshake. Put the vectors under "vectors" in the
// golden file and set "platform_commit" to <SHA>.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"axonflow/platform/decision/contract"
)

type vector struct {
	ID           string                `json:"id"`
	PEPID        string                `json:"pep_id"`
	Audience     string                `json:"audience"`
	Capabilities []contract.Capability `json:"capabilities"`
	Header       string                `json:"header"`
}

func c(t string, v int) contract.Capability {
	return contract.Capability{Type: contract.ObligationType(t), Version: v}
}

func main() {
	// The 64-capability construction: every declared type in canonical order
	// at version 1, then 2, and so on, stopping at the count cap.
	var sixtyFour []contract.Capability
	types := contract.AllObligationTypes()
	for v := 1; v <= 5; v++ {
		for _, t := range types {
			if len(sixtyFour) < contract.MaxPEPHandshakeCapabilities {
				sixtyFour = append(sixtyFour, contract.Capability{Type: t, Version: v})
			}
		}
	}
	in := []vector{
		{ID: "empty", PEPID: "sdk-python", Audience: "https://pep.example.test", Capabilities: []contract.Capability{}},
		{ID: "unsorted", PEPID: "gateway.request-1", Audience: "urn:example:aud", Capabilities: []contract.Capability{
			c("field_redact", 2), c("approval_challenge", 1), c("field_redact", 1), c("notification", 3)}},
		{ID: "minimal", PEPID: "a", Audience: "A", Capabilities: []contract.Capability{c("step_up_authentication", 1)}},
		{ID: "sixty-four", PEPID: "p", Audience: "a", Capabilities: sixtyFour},
	}
	for i := range in {
		h := contract.PEPHandshake{
			ProfileVersion: contract.PEPHandshakeProfileV1,
			PEPID:          in[i].PEPID,
			Audience:       in[i].Audience,
			Capabilities:   in[i].Capabilities,
		}
		enc, ref := h.Encode()
		if ref != nil {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "encode %s: %s\n", in[i].ID, ref.Error())
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		if _, ref := contract.DecodePEPHandshake(enc); ref != nil {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "decode %s: %s\n", in[i].ID, ref.Error())
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		in[i].Header = enc
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "types=%d sixty-four=%d\n", len(types), len(sixtyFour))
	out := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	out.SetIndent("", "  ")
	if err := out.Encode(in); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
